# Vendor

Skills copied verbatim from other people's repos, kept here so they install the same way as mine. Not promoted in the plugin, no docs pages. Each source folder keeps its upstream `LICENSE`. To update one, re-copy it from upstream and update its commit below.

## cursor-team-kit

From [`cursor/plugins`](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/1ba91fc25c0977741dd0e267849e6234b037ed0a/cursor-team-kit) at `1ba91fc`. MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Cursor. pstack's `poteto-mode` calls these but doesn't bundle them.

- **[deslop](./cursor-team-kit/deslop/SKILL.md)**: Remove AI-generated code slop from the branch's diff against main.
- **[control-cli](./cursor-team-kit/control-cli/SKILL.md)**: Build or adapt a local harness to drive, inspect, and profile an interactive CLI or TUI.
- **[control-ui](./cursor-team-kit/control-ui/SKILL.md)**: Build or adapt a local browser/CDP harness to drive and inspect a web, IDE, or Electron UI.
